visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed rotating banner (6 slides, arrows + autoplay). Background image per slide, left-aligned heading, description and pill CTA(s). Optional second picture per slide is used as the mobile banner.
contentPattern: One row per slide. Cell 1: picture (desktop) + optional second picture (mobile). Cell 2: heading (title), optional paragraph(s) (summary), 1-2 links (primary and secondary CTA). Optional headless source: leading 2-cell config rows in any order, 'Fonte'/'Source' (banner list URL, app proxy, channel or persisted-query path; empty = authored slides only), 'Público'/'Audience', 'Escopo Target'/'Target scope'; they are removed and the remaining authored rows become the fallback. Universal Editor: the config rows are the block fields fonte/publico/escopoTarget and the slides are 'carousel-hero-item' items; in the editor the authored slides are always shown (no Content Fragment fetch, no autoplay) with an editor-only badge.

cfMapping.resumo: paragraph(s) of cell 2 (resumo.plaintext or string; blank lines split paragraphs)
cfMapping.imagem: cell 1, first picture (desktop). ImageRef (jpg: _publishUrl/_dynamicUrl/width/height) or DocumentRef (webp: _path/_publishUrl); _publishUrl > aem-publish-url + _path > _dynamicUrl with width params
cfMapping.ctaTexto/ctaLink: first link (primary CTA); only http(s) or site-relative hrefs
cfMapping.ativoDe/ativoAte: slide shown only between these dates when present (date-only ativoAte is inclusive)
cfMapping.publico: client-side audience filter: kept when empty, 'todos' or equal to the audience in use

usage: Home page hero rotating promotional banners (Imoveis a venda, App Copel, Copel Agro, Seguro Protege, Copel investe, Leilao federal).
reuseGuidance: Use for full-width rotating promotional banners where each slide has an image, title, optional summary and up to two CTAs. Keep the 2-cell row structure stable: it is the contract for feeding slides from AEM headless banner Content Fragments. Slides without summary are supported; a single slide renders without navigation.

configRows.value: Absolute URL on another host (app proxy e.g. https://<app-domain>/api/banners?canal=site, or AEM persisted query) fetched as written; a channel ('site'/'app') uses config.json aem-banners-url ({canal} template) or <aem-publish-url>/graphql/execute.json/global/banners-por-canal;canal=<canal>; a persisted-query path resolves on aem-publish-url. Empty = no Content Fragments (authored slides only).
Audience whose banners are shown (default visitante).

Adobe Target decision scope. With window.alloy, the decided {"bannerPath"} moves that banner first (fetched with global/banner-por-path;path=<raw path> or aem-banner-by-path-url when not in the list) and a propositionDisplay event is sent.

audience.filter: keep items whose publico is empty, 'todos' or the audience in use
audience.personalization: none in code; per-person choice via Adobe Target (Escopo Target row)

headlessSource.fallback: Authored rows render immediately and stay when the fetch fails, times out (4s), returns no matching items or the source cannot be resolved. Without authored rows a hero-height skeleton is shown, and the block is hidden if no banners arrive.
headlessSource.cors: AEM publish sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin for aem.page/aem.live (nor on cached GET for localhost); browsers use the app proxy URL.
